subject.title: [Feature]: Keep Codex app-server with Gateway for remote execution

question: Should OpenClaw add a bundled Codex plugin experimental remoteExecution config that keeps app-server local over stdio while selecting authenticated remote Codex exec-server environments?
rationale: The issue adds a new remote execution and credential boundary, changes session/runtime identity semantics, and deliberately fail-closes unsupported combinations; automation cannot choose that product/security tradeoff without maintainer intent.

options.title: Proceed behind experimental proof gate
options.body: Keep the issue open and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101326 only after security/product acceptance, reconciliation with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101221, and live registry-backed executor proof.

options.title: Defer until Codex contract stabilizes
options.body: Keep the design tracked here but do not land the config until upstream registry-backed execution APIs are no longer too experimental for OpenClaw operators.

options.title: Stay with remote WebSocket for now
options.body: Reject the new topology for now and keep the existing authenticated remote WebSocket app-server path as the only supported remote mode despite the split lifecycle tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Proceed behind experimental proof gate
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101326 only after security/product acceptance, reconciliation with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101221, and live registry-backed executor proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored this protected design item and is carrying the candidate implementation plus related app-server lifecycle cleanup, making them the strongest available decision owner signal.
